note: Three attempts at PAD-US, three 400s - and the last one said Invalid URL for the service root itself, not just the query. So the path shape is wrong, not the parameters: PADUS3_0ManagerName is probably a MapServer rather than a FeatureServer. This prints each service beside its type instead of assuming one.

The other route to BLM polygons, and closer to home. The surface-management service the public lands layer already uses has a sublayer of its own; if it answers a bbox query with geometry, hatching becomes a styling decision and PAD-US stops mattering.
